instruction.text:
An animal conservation centre recently recorded the weights of their birds of prey in kilograms.

Listen to the weight and select the matching number.

atoms.sound: The Eurasian eagle owl weighs 2.75 kilograms.

hint.text: A raptor, or bird of prey, is a large bird that eats vertebrates, meaning animals that have a backbone.
hint.label: Raptor

instruction.text: Take a look at the table and decide if the statement is true or false.

atoms.a: The osprey is the heaviest of the raptors.
The Eurasian eagle owl is 1.5 kilograms heavier than the red-tailed hawk.
The red-tailed hawk and red-footed falcon are the same weight.
There are three raptors heavier than one kilo.
The osprey is heavier than one and a half kilos.

instruction.text: Sort the raptors by weight, with the heaviest raptor on top.
